description: Per-site load inputs of the real-site pilot (p1/batch pilot profile): the May page is the decoded HTML of the listed Common Crawl WARC record (cc_volatility_analysis.decode), loaded offline by p1/RealPilotOffline.cs with the clock at 'timestamp'; vol_ids / vol_classes are the Oracle-determined lists (pilot_rule.md section 6) the observations were dumped with. The HTML is not stored here; html_sha256 pins its bytes.
